_why: Proves the harness cannot leave a typed-in file dirty. Recipes type into REAL files under src/test-django-project; a dirty buffer makes 'Close All Editors' pop a save prompt that stalls the run, and killing VS Code with one makes hot exit restore it into the next run. Each hook throws on failure, so this recipe is self-checking: exit 0 means the guarantee holds. Run it after touching engine.mjs discardEdits.

actions.as: the edit really landed (else the rest proves nothing)
actions.js: (()=>{const n=document.querySelectorAll('.tab.dirty').length; if(!n) throw new Error('no dirty tab after typing — selector wrong or insertText did not land'); return n;})()
(()=>{const n=document.querySelectorAll('.tab.dirty').length; if(n) throw new Error(n+' dirty tab(s) survived discardEdits'); return 'clean';})()
(()=>{const d=document.querySelectorAll('.monaco-dialog-box, .dialog-shadow').length; if(d) throw new Error('a modal dialog is open — close-all prompted to save'); return 'no dialog';})()

actions.as: no editors left open at all
actions.js: (()=>{const t=document.querySelectorAll('.tabs-container .tab').length; if(t) throw new Error(t+' editor tab(s) still open'); return 'closed';})()
